title: Building inventory
description: Building identity, classification, purpose group, storeys and spaces.

title: Storey inventory
description: All linked storeys, including records with no optional classification.

title: Space inventory
description: Spaces, their storeys, uses and areas within each building.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?building ?usage (COUNT(DISTINCT ?space) AS ?count) WHERE {
 ?building a bot:Building; bot:hasStorey/bot:hasSpace ?space .
 OPTIONAL { ?space ficr:hasSpaceUsage ?usage }
} GROUP BY ?building ?usage ORDER BY ?building ?usage
title: Space use summary
description: Distinct spaces by use, with missing uses retained as unbound values.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?elementType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?element) AS ?count) WHERE {
 VALUES ?elementType { ficr:Wall ficr:ExternalWall ficr:FloorSlab ficr:RoofSlab ficr:Doorset
 ficr:Window ficr:Opening ficr:Beam ficr:Ceiling ficr:Railing ficr:Stair ficr:StairFlight
 ficr:WallFoundation ficr:Furnishings ficr:FireExtinguisher ficr:Alarm }
 ?element a ?elementType .
} GROUP BY ?elementType ORDER BY ?elementType
title: Element classifications
description: Membership counts across 16 reporting classes. Classes may overlap.

title: Elements and equipment by space
description: Contained or adjacent fabric elements and located fire-protection equipment.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?result (COUNT(DISTINCT ?finding) AS ?count) WHERE {
 ?finding a ficr:ComplianceFinding; ficr:hasComplianceResult ?result; ficr:concernsElement ?element .
} GROUP BY ?result ORDER BY ?result
title: REI result summary
description: Compliant, noncompliant and undetermined outcomes for the 44 selected checks.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?finding ?element ?requirement ?category ?actualREI ?requiredREI ?result WHERE {
 ?finding a ficr:ComplianceFinding; ficr:concernsElement ?element; ficr:checksRequirement ?requirement; ficr:hasComplianceResult ?result .
 OPTIONAL { ?element ficr:hasActualREI ?actualREI }
 ?requirement ficr:hasRequiredREI ?requiredREI .
 BIND(IF(EXISTS { ?element a ficr:CompartmentWall },"CompartmentWall","Other element") AS ?category)
} ORDER BY ?finding
title: Element REI detail
description: Actual and required fire resistance for each selected element, including missing values.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT DISTINCT ?element ?assignedRole ?inferredClass ?retainsExternalWall WHERE {
 VALUES (?assignedRole ?inferredClass) { (ficr:FireSeparatingRole ficr:CompartmentWall) }
 ?element ficr:hasPhysicalObjectFireSafetyRole ?assignedRole; a ?inferredClass; a ficr:Wall .
 BIND(EXISTS { ?element a ficr:ExternalWall } AS ?retainsExternalWall)
} ORDER BY ?element
title: Fire-separating role inference
description: Compartment-wall classification inferred from an assigned fire-separating role.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?finding ?element ?requirement ?actualREI ?requiredREI ?result ?evidenceStatus ?clause ?source WHERE {
 ?finding a ficr:ComplianceFinding; ficr:concernsElement ?element; ficr:checksRequirement ?requirement; ficr:hasComplianceResult ?result .
 OPTIONAL { ?finding ficr:hasEvidenceStatus ?evidenceStatus }
 OPTIONAL { ?element ficr:hasActualREI ?actualREI }
 ?requirement ficr:hasRequiredREI ?requiredREI; ficr:hasClauseReference ?clause; ficr:derivedFromRegulatorySource ?source .
} ORDER BY ?finding
title: Compliance evidence and sources
description: Trace each REI finding through its requirement, clause and regulatory source.

title: Risk-unit coverage
description: Risk units, installation and explicit space membership.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?unit ?conditionState (COUNT(DISTINCT ?boundary) AS ?count) WHERE {
 ?boundary a ficr:BoundaryAssumption; ficr:appliesToRiskUnit ?unit; ficr:hasConditionState ?conditionState .
} GROUP BY ?unit ?conditionState ORDER BY ?unit ?conditionState
title: Boundary condition summary
description: Distinct boundary records grouped by unit and condition state.

title: Boundary evidence detail
description: Conditions, evidence availability and adequacy for each boundary aspect.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?unit (COUNT(DISTINCT ?boundary) AS ?totalAssumptions)
 (SUM(?unknown) AS ?unknownCount) (SUM(?compromised) AS ?compromisedCount)
 (SUM(?gap) AS ?evidenceGapCount) (SUM(?unknown+?compromised+?gap) AS ?priorityScore) WHERE {
 ?boundary a ficr:BoundaryAssumption; ficr:appliesToRiskUnit ?unit; ficr:hasConditionState ?state .
 BIND(IF(?state=ficr:Unknown,1,0) AS ?unknown)
 BIND(IF(?state=ficr:Compromised,1,0) AS ?compromised)
 BIND(IF(?state=ficr:Unknown && NOT EXISTS { ?boundary ficr:supportedByEvidence ?evidence },1,0) AS ?gap)
} GROUP BY ?unit ORDER BY DESC(?priorityScore) DESC(?compromisedCount) ?unit
title: Information priority
description: Unit-level P = U + C + G, counting each boundary once despite multiple evidence links.

title: Boundary consistency checks
description: Missing or conflicting states and contradictions between evidence status and links.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?finding ?fireScenario ?boundary ?evidence ?unit ?conditionState ?evidenceStatus WHERE {
 ?finding a ficr:RiskFinding; ficr:concernsRiskUnit ?unit; ficr:derivedFromScenario ?fireScenario .
 ?fireScenario ficr:dependsOnBoundaryCondition ?boundary .
 ?boundary ficr:appliesToRiskUnit ?unit; ficr:hasConditionState ?conditionState .
 OPTIONAL { ?boundary ficr:hasEvidenceStatus ?evidenceStatus }
 OPTIONAL { ?boundary ficr:supportedByEvidence ?evidence }
} ORDER BY ?unit ?boundary ?evidence
title: Risk finding support
description: Trace a risk finding through its fire scenario, boundary and evidence.

title: Assessment workflow
description: Event, task and assessment relationships, with planned and actual times kept separate.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?assessment ?finding ?requirement ?element ?result ?requiredREI ?clause ?source WHERE {
 ?assessment a ficr:ComplianceChecking; ficr:producesFinding ?finding .
 ?finding a ficr:ComplianceFinding; ficr:concernsElement ?element; ficr:hasComplianceResult ?result; ficr:checksRequirement ?requirement .
 ?requirement ficr:hasRequiredREI ?requiredREI; ficr:hasClauseReference ?clause; ficr:derivedFromRegulatorySource ?source .
} ORDER BY ?finding
title: Compliance workflow
description: Assessments and compliance findings linked to the requirements they check.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT DISTINCT ?assessment ?sourceRecord ?inspectionID ?assessedDate ?actualStart ?workbookIdentifier ?revision ?sheet ?recordID WHERE {
 ?assessment a ficr:InspectionAssessment; dcterms:date ?assessedDate; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?inspectionRecord .
 ?inspectionRecord dcterms:hasPart [ dcterms:type field:inspection-id; rdf:value ?inspectionID ] .
 { ?assessment prov:wasDerivedFrom ?sourceRecord } UNION { ?assessment ficr:producesFinding/prov:wasDerivedFrom ?sourceRecord }
 ?sourceRecord dcterms:isPartOf ?workbook; dcterms:identifier ?recordID;
   dcterms:hasPart [ dcterms:type field:source-sheet; rdf:value ?sheet ] .
 FILTER(STR(?sheet) IN ("Inspection","Observations"))
 ?workbook dcterms:identifier ?workbookIdentifier; dcterms:hasVersion ?revision .
 OPTIONAL { ?assessment prov:startedAtTime ?actualStart }
} ORDER BY ?sourceRecord
title: Inspection source register
description: Inspection date, workbook revision, worksheet and source-record identifiers.

title: Equipment inspection detail
description: Service deadlines, physical condition, functional tests and criterion-level outcomes.

title: Inspection evidence
description: Source records and evidence supporting equipment and door inspection findings.

text:
PREFIX ficr: <https://w3id.org/ficr#>
PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX field: <urn:ficr:record-field:>
PREFIX outcome: <urn:ficr:inspection-outcome:>

SELECT ?assessment (COUNT(DISTINCT ?device) AS ?devices) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?finding) AS ?checks)
 (SUM(IF(?outcome=outcome:pass,1,0)) AS ?passedChecks)
 (SUM(IF(?outcome=outcome:deficiency,1,0)) AS ?deficientChecks)
 (SUM(IF(?outcome=outcome:unresolved,1,0)) AS ?unresolvedChecks)
 (COUNT(DISTINCT ?badDevice) AS ?devicesWithDeficiency)
 (COUNT(DISTINCT ?unknownDevice) AS ?devicesWithUnresolvedChecks) WHERE {
 ?assessment a ficr:InspectionAssessment; ficr:producesFinding ?finding .
 ?finding a ficr:InspectionFinding; ficr:concernsElement ?device; dcterms:type ?outcome .
 ?device a ficr:FireProtectionEquipment .
 BIND(IF(?outcome=outcome:deficiency,?device,1/0) AS ?badDevice)
 BIND(IF(?outcome=outcome:unresolved,?device,1/0) AS ?unknownDevice)
} GROUP BY ?assessment ORDER BY ?assessment
title: Equipment inspection summary
description: Separate totals for devices, selected checks, deficient checks and affected devices.
